title: Independent API limits and refreshed DGX Spark recipes
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-11 adds individually configurable API-key limits and refreshes ready-to-use DGX Spark recipes for current optimized model runtimes.
changes: Configure TPM, RPM, maximum parallel requests, model TPM, and model RPM independently for every API key from Settings, with existing keys remaining unlimited by default.
Enforce total and model-only API limits at the authenticated gateway, report HTTP 429 with Retry-After, and account for token usage from both regular and streaming inference responses.
Update MiaLabs' two-Spark DeepSeek V4 Flash recipe to its current pinned compatibility and performance hotfix image, serving profile, and image smoke checks.
Add the MiaLabs Qwen 3.8 27B NVFP4 ready-to-use recipe for a single DGX Spark.
